name: jaipilot
description: Deterministic guardrails that cut down agentic drift for high-quality agentic Java changes.

defaultPrompt: Generate Java tests and prove them with coverage and PIT.
Review and prove every changed Java production file.
Fix smells, complexity, and duplication in changed Java.
